error_contract.native_command_generation: New void COPY/list/queue operations acquire an exact-generation copied callback lease before operation; child retirement cannot retarget notification to a replacement native context.

error_contract.image_failed_create_collection: RetireDevice retries hidden buffer and image rollback cleanup before checking child ownership. error_contract.native_descriptor_generation: Genuine CPU RTV heap/view callbacks retain exact-generation native callback leases. error_contract.descriptor_arena_claims: Descriptor CPU arena bounds attach to the exact global descriptor-heap child before publication. All native storage claims and output copies exclude the range. Retirement removes descriptor lookup, destroys views/releases image leases, frees arena while range exclusion remains, then releases native child/range; no external calls occur under the common lock.
error_contract.render_target_command_references: Distinct bound/clear RTV leases retain exact descriptor generation, actual image/view/heap and allocator during recording and all attempted submissions. Referenced slot overwrite/heap retirement return BUSY. Reset detaches old pending owners; own completion or explicit safe drain alone permits retirement. Completed unchanged one-shot lists retain references until reset/retirement. No external platform calls occur under the policy lock.
error_contract.image_transition_command_references: Separate genuine original R0 ResourceBarrier bundle retains an initialized ImageLease and exact DIRECT allocator through a closed same-image RT/COPY_SOURCE/RT transaction. Missing required Vulkan procedure fails before attempt and preserves retry. Reset detaches attempted owners; unknown submission/failed completion remains terminal with owners retained through failed drain. Safe drain permits cleanup without successful state rollback. The original transition-only bundle keeps its ABI; a separate bounded image-readback bundle now connects the copy between explicit transitions. No inter-list image state persistence is supplied.
error_contract.image_readback_command_references: Genuine original R0 copy callbacks snapshot active placed-resource footprints and retain one exclusive exact same-device READBACK write lease alongside the initialized-image lease. Nonzero resource references, active maps, stale/cross-device cookies, wrong source sequence and invalid logical footprint reject. Missing required copy procedure fails before an attempt and is retryable. Unknown/failed actual attempts preserve original terminal outcome and resources through failed drain; safe drain permits cleanup without success. Reset detaches both resources and old completion cannot mutate replacement recording. Both acquisition orders exclude conflicting ordinary COPY and image-readback leases under the common lock, while ordinary COPY sharing remains valid. Exact cookie/token/adapter and sole-reference checks guard release of the private exclusive-write ownership state.
error_contract.image_upload_command_references: A non-Copy UploadLease pins exact live native resource cookie/backend token/adapter. Read-only image-upload lists and ordinary COPY source leases may share in either acquisition order. Every map, operating source, stale/wrong-device/wrong-kind source and counter overflow refuses acquisition. Only its exact release decrements its own reference; existing exclusive READBACK write ownership remains unchanged. Recording and completed-unreset lists keep source/image/allocator leases. Actual accepted or unknown attempts keep all owners through failed observation/drain. Own observed completion or safe drain alone permits detached cleanup; reset/reused generations cannot be changed by old completion. Failed terminal work is never reported as successful upload.

caller_storage_contract: Runtime owns valid aligned storage through every call and until successful retirement and all overlapping calls return

implementation_credit: Experimental actual native runtime storage/private-size, copied callback/error path, parent/child ownership and real empty Vulkan allocator pool/reset are production implementation; complete native device and complete command-list/queue behavior remain absent

runtime_execution_status.callback: Copy optional genuine pKTCallbacks.pfnEscapeCb at CreateDevice; retain callback code and exact hRTDevice under native generation leases. Runtime adapter handle comes from the actual retained OpenAdapter context.
runtime_execution_status.marshalling: D3DDDICB_ESCAPE with DeviceStatusQuery1, HardwareAccess0, null context and an initialized exact D3DDDI_EXECUTIONSTATEESCAPE. The runtime processes this status query before KMD escape dispatch.
runtime_execution_status.admission: A per-device in-progress flag excludes recursive or parallel status Escapes. Callback invocation occurs outside the common policy lock; busy retirement and adapter-close attempts preserve the generation until callback return.
runtime_execution_status.loss: Only exact S_OK with RESET/STOPPED, D3DDDIERR_DEVICEREMOVED or DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_REMOVED confirms loss. Failed, pending, unknown and other execution states are inconclusive. A confirmed reset conservatively invalidates the shared selected backend and feeds existing one-time native SetError notification and safe teardown.
runtime_execution_status.consumers: Private GetDeviceRemovedReason probes the actual runtime device even without fences or a Vulkan device. Existing queue/fence workers sample eligible runtime contexts at most once per32ms per device, without manufacturing a KMT monitoring device.
runtime_execution_status.boundaries: A missing optional Escape callback preserves legacy private behavior. Devices with no active worker are probed on explicit status query. Full public runtime advertisement and hibernation remain separate incomplete contracts.

mapped_resource_profile.callback_copy: Genuine device paging/map/free callbacks and genuine core-layer residency callbacks are copied; no callback table pointer survives CreateDevice.
mapped_resource_profile.residency_lifetime: Exact buffer/image heap pins and a native callback lease span runtime calls outside locks. Partial acquisition is rolled back, duplicate objects preserve the actual OS request list, and pending residency results retain their returned fence meaning.
mapped_resource_profile.device_loss: Confirmed removal from allocation or mapping failures faults the shared native device before further publication.

single_node_topology.source: The retained Lightning adapter identity admits one guest physical adapter and one visible node; this is independent of host Vulkan enumeration indices.
single_node_topology.result: Guest physical adapter mask1; the exact one-element physical-to-logical map contains node ordinal0.
single_node_topology.admission: Copied native callback lease spans exact generation lookup and error reporting. Rust validates aligned non-aliased output and publishes only under atomic native fault admission.
single_node_topology.failure: Wrong physical count, NULL/misaligned/claimed output or lost device leaves output unchanged. Invalid/retired device returns no mask and never dereferences unknown storage.
